front: 隨著……的發展，越來越多……
back: Along with the development of..., more and more...
note: Along with = 隨著，後接名詞；more and more 後可接名詞或形容詞。

front: 關於是否……有著長期的辯論。
back: There is a long-running debate as to whether...
note: as to 是固定介詞搭配（= 關於），不能寫成 about that；whether 引導的是名詞從句。

front: 普遍/廣泛認為……
back: It is commonly / generally / widely believed / accepted / recognized / known / agreed that...
note: ★ 講義原文就在這兩處畫了底線，幾乎確定是空格位置。副詞與過去分詞任意組合都成立，寫其中一個即可。

front: 就……而言
back: As far as... is concerned,
note: concerned 用被動，不能寫成 concerning；主詞放在 as far as 和 is concerned 中間。

front: 近年……引起公眾關注。
back: In recent years, the problem of ... has aroused / caused public concern.
note: arouse / cause public concern 是固定搭配；concern 此處為不可數名詞，不加 s。

segments.text: In recent years, the problem of ... has

front: 當被問及……大多數人會想到……
back: When asked about... most people would think of... / When it comes to... most people would hold the view that...
note: When asked 是 When they are asked 的省略（主詞一致才能省）；when it comes to 的 to 是介詞，後接名詞或動名詞。

front: 任何事物都有兩面性，……也不例外。
back: Everything has two sides and... is not an exception.
note: exception 是可數名詞，前面必須加冠詞 an。

front: 多年來，……一直被視為……，但現在的情況有很大的不同。
back: For years, ... has been seen as..., but things are quite different now.
note: 現在完成式被動 has been seen as，強調從過去持續到現在；see A as B = 把 A 視為 B。

front: 正如諺語所說的，……
back: As the proverb says, ...
note: proverb = 諺語（不是 sentence / word）；as 引導方式從句，動詞用第三人稱單數 says。

front: 眾所周知，任何人沒有……都是不能……的。
back: As we all know, everybody can't ... without...
note: can't ... without... 是雙重否定表肯定（沒有……就不能……）。

front: 有幾個原因，但在一般情況下，它們歸結為三個主要方面，分別是……
back: There are several reasons for..., but in general, they come down to three major ones, which are...
note: come down to = 歸結為（三個詞缺一不可）；in general = 一般而言。

segments.text: There are several reasons for..., but

front: 我們該採取措施解決……問題了。
back: It's high time we took measures to solve the problem of...
note: ★★ 虛擬語氣：It's high time + 主詞 + 過去式，必須寫 took 不能寫 take。這是這一頁最經典、最可能出的一個空。

segments.text: measures to solve the problem of...

front: 原因如下。
back: The reasons are as follows.
note: as follows 是固定用法，follows 永遠帶 s，不隨主詞單複數變化（不能寫 as follow）。

front: 我無法完全同意……，因為……。
back: I cannot entirely agree with the idea that...because ....
note: cannot entirely 是部分否定（= 不完全同意），不等於完全不同意；agree with 後接人或意見。

front: 坦率地說，我不能同意他們的意見，理由如下。
back: To be frank, I cannot agree with this opinion for the reasons below.
note: To be frank 是獨立不定式作狀語（= 坦率地說），也可說 To be honest。

segments.text: , I cannot agree with this opinion

front: 我對這個問題的看法如下。
back: My argument for this view goes as follows.
note: argument for = 支持某觀點的論述（介詞用 for）；go as follows = 內容如下。

front: 就我而言，我完全同意前者/後者。
back: As far as I am concerned, I completely agree with the former / the latter.
note: the former = 前者，the latter = 後者，兩個都必須加 the。

segments.text: As far as I am concerned

front: 在我看來，做………比做………更明智。
back: In my point of view, it is more advisable to ...than to ...
note: advisable = 明智的、可取的；more advisable to A than to B，兩邊都要有 to。

front: 有很多方法可以解決這個問題，但下面的可能是最有效的。
back: Many ways can contribute to solving this problem, but the following ones may be most effective.
note: ★ contribute to 的 to 是介詞，後面必須接動名詞 solving，寫 solve 就錯了。

front: 有兩條理由可以證明……分別是……
back: There are two reasons contributing to..., which are ...
note: 現在分詞 contributing 作後置定語修飾 reasons（= 導致……的兩條理由）。
